row.notes: Needs flag +0x17e set and count +0x38 nonzero, then walks the occupied slots of the bitmap hash table (+0x28 slots, +0x30 control words). For each entry FUN_142ba7d30(entry+8, &vec) yields a vector of 0x18-byte items (object +8, weak control block +0x10); each weak ref is locked and if object+0x28 == key the entry's leading uint32 id is returned, else 0 after the full scan. Context from caller: Game_Customisation_FilterUnlockTree, FUN_14194d270 (same item classification loop), FUN_141a4d850 (large builder repeating that loop per item category) and 0x141febfa0 all pass store+0x68 and the item's int at +0xa4 right after Ui_Purchase_BuildTierButtons; nonzero result routes the item into a set keyed by that id.
